name: Gift of Mabar (Recharge 5-6)
description: The creature draws on the Endless Night, releasing a burst of life-draining darkness in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (2d8) necrotic damage and become blinded for 1 minute. A blinded creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a success.
